description: This file contains the definition of the Backup class within the Opencart Admin Model Tool namespace. The class provides methods for retrieving database table information, such as listing all tables, querying records, and getting total record counts, which are likely used for backup purposes.

classes.name: Backup
classes.description: A class for handling database backup operations, including retrieving table names, records, and record counts.

methods.name: getTables
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all database tables in the current database that have the specified prefix.

methods.name: getRecords
methods.description: Fetches a subset of records from a specific table with pagination support.

methods.name: getTotalRecords
methods.description: Returns the total number of records in a specified table.
